items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Joe Zawinul on “Mercy Mercy.” [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. Yes.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. They had everything. And the Wurlitzer was before the Fender Rhodes. It was the first electric keyboard. You know that’s the one Ray Charles played on “What’d I Say” that just blew everybody’s mind.

Yes. Yes. And it was the first opportunity for a keyboard player to have a volume control. You know the guitar players had volume, but keyboard players had a microphone stuck in an upright piano. You know it wasn’t fair competition. The Wurlitzer was great.
